sandbachFocus: Sandbach United delivered a devastating performance away at Telford Town on Saturday, securing a 6-0 victory to maintain their position at the top of the table. Kyle Foley starred with a hat-trick, while Kieran O'Connell, Robbie Hatton and Birchall also found the net. The Bach were ruthless throughout, establishing a 3-0 lead by half-time and adding three more in the second half to secure a clean sheet and extend their winning run.
divisionWide: Eccleshall won convincingly at home against New Mills (2-0), with goals from Nicky Parker and Danny Glover, maintaining their strong recent form with five wins in their last six league games. Wolverhampton Casuals also secured three points with a 2-0 victory over Foley Meir at Brinsford Stadium, with Kieran Cook and Leo Wood on target. AFC Bridgnorth defeated Stafford Town 4-1 away in an entertaining encounter, coming from behind after Stafford took an early lead. Allscott Heath won 4-0 at home against Wednesfield Community, with George Cross scoring a hat-trick and Kian Newnes also netting. Shawbury United claimed a 2-0 away victory at Brereton Social with goals from Hess and Woody. Dawley Town secured an impressive 3-1 away win at Crewe despite falling behind early, scoring twice in quick succession through Cian Fenlon and a bicycle kick finish. Cheadle Heath Nomads and Bilston Town played out a 1-1 draw. Alsager Town drew 0-0 at home against Widnes Town in a competitive bottom-half clash. Barnton's match against Market Drayton Town was abandoned at 3-0 after a serious injury to a Market Drayton player; the fixture will await a league committee decision.
